cmd.dashboard.name: dashboard
help.title: NEXUS BOT commands
help.body:
**General** · `/help` `/ping` `/dashboard` `/invite` `/remind` `/tag` `/afk` `/report` · right click → Apps
**Info** · `/info server|user|avatar|banner|role|bot|color`
**Fun** · `/fun 8ball|coinflip|roll|choose|rps|tictactoe|ship` `/poll`
**Community** · `/event create|list` `/suggest` `/ticket open|close|claim` `/rank` `/leaderboard` `/voicetime` `/voicetop` `/voice`
**Economy** · `/balance` `/daily` `/weekly` `/work` `/pay` `/shop` `/buy` `/inventory` `/bet` `/slots` `/rob` `/crime`
**Moderation** · `/warn` `/timeout` `/kick` `/ban` `/softban` `/unban` `/warnings` `/case` `/note` `/pardon` `/clearwarns` `/modstats` `/snipe` `/editsnipe`
**Channels & raids** · `/purge` `/slowmode` `/lock` `/unlock` `/nuke` `/lockdown` `/massban` `/raidmode` `/quarantine` `/release`
**Staff** · `/embed` `/embed-edit` `/say` `/announce` `/role` `/nick` `/giveaway` `/xp` `/money` `/welcome`
help.footer: Configure everything from the web dashboard
